subject: Acceptance gating matrix & closure checklist for AurumTech private offer
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: AurumTech Procurement <procurement@aurumtech.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@aurumtech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AurumTech private offer — draft acceptance gating matrix

Hi Maya / Aurum procurement team,

Following our call this morning, attaching a draft acceptance-gate checklist and mutual action plan (MAP) that stitches the AWS Private Offer steps to our billing/onboarding path. The goal: align milestones so we can sign, activate the private offer in AWS, and invoice within the same sprint.

Key asks from Redwood: 
- Confirmation of the internal approvers and the target PO issuance date.
- Any additional compliance evidence you need (SOC2 scope, retention windows).
- Decision: invoice to master account or project-specific cost center.

What’s attached: AurumTech-MAP-v2.xlsx (milestone matrix), RDW-SLA-exception-request.pdf (if you need an SLA carveout), and a sample PO template.

High-level timeline we recommend:
1) Vendor legal review + redlines — 3 business days
2) Procurement PO issuance — within 2 business days after legal sign-off
3) AWS Private Offer activation — 1 business day after PO + marketplace onboarding
4) First invoice sent within 5 business days of activation

If that looks reasonable, Karthik will coordinate the technical acceptance tests and Laura will follow up on legal redlines. Can you confirm approvers and a preferred signature route (DocuSign vs email PDF)?

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0172

Attachments: AurumTech-MAP-v2.xlsx, RDW-SLA-exception-request.pdf, AurumTech-PO-template.docx

From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@aurumtech.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: AurumTech Procurement <procurement@aurumtech.com>, AurumTech Legal <legal@aurumtech.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Nov 2028 10:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AurumTech private offer — draft acceptance gating matrix

Jonas — thanks for the summary and the attachments. Quick notes from Procurement: 

- Approvers: myself (Procurement), plus VP Finance (Elena Park) for any multi-cloud commitments > $150k ARR.
- Preferred signature: DocuSign is preferred. Please include the master account billing address and our project code (AT-GEN-42) on the PO.
- Compliance: we will need a short SOC2 scoping statement and confirmation on data region for logs. Can your team confirm logs are retained in us-west-2 and retention length?

We’ve attached our standard PO template for your intake team (AurumTech-PO-template.docx). Procurement can issue the PO within 1-2 business days after legal clears redlines.

Maya Singh
Senior Procurement Manager
AurumTech
procurement@aurumtech.com

Attachment: AurumTech-PO-template.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@aurumtech.com>, procurement@aurumtech.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Nov 2028 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AurumTech private offer — draft acceptance gating matrix

Thanks Maya — answering the compliance/ops points inline and proposing acceptance criteria for the MAP.

- Logs/data residency: Redwood can ensure inference logs and audit trails live in us-west-2 for your tenant; retention is configurable — default 90 days but we can extend to 365 days for regulated workloads. I’ve attached the small SLA exception request (RDW-SLA-exception-request.pdf) for Laura to sign off if needed.
- Technical acceptance tests (proposed):
  * End-to-end sample prompt set — pass rate >= 95% for regression checks
  * Latency smoke test — p95 <= 450ms for 512-token synthetic workload
  * Billing verification — token accounting verified against our test invoice

Suggested acceptance gating matrix (we updated the spreadsheet):
- Legal redlines cleared -> Procurement to issue PO -> DocuSign signature -> AWS private offer activation -> Smoke test -> Invoice

Laura — could you review the SLA carve and the proposed acceptance criteria? If legal is quick we can ask Procurement for PO issuance by Friday (2028-12-01). Jonas — I’ll schedule the smoke tests once we have the activation ETA from AWS marketplace.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: legal@aurumtech.com, Maya Singh <maya.singh@aurumtech.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Dec 2028 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AurumTech private offer — draft acceptance gating matrix

Hi Maya / Aurum legal,

I reviewed the draft and have three narrow redlines: 1) limit data retention exception to audit logs only; 2) clarify indemnity cap tied to fees paid in the prior 12 months; 3) explicit SLA credits calculation (service credits vs invoice credits). I marked these in the attached redline packet.

We can accept DocuSign for signature. I’m publishing a short concession memo and a DocuSign packet for signature here: https://docusign.com/packet/7f3a-aurumtech-sign

If you agree to the three points above we can route back to Procurement for PO issuance the same day and request AWS marketplace activation within 24 hours of receiving the signed DocuSign.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Attachment: RDW-legal-redlines-aurntech.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@aurumtech.com>, procurement@aurumtech.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, AWS Marketplace <marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Dec 2028 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: AurumTech private offer — draft acceptance gating matrix

Great — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Summary & next steps (agreed):
- Laura’s three redlines accepted by Aurum legal (pending Maya confirmation)
- DocuSign packet issued: https://docusign.com/packet/7f3a-aurumtech-sign
- Procurement to issue PO referencing project AT-GEN-42 and send to marketplace@amazon.com once signed
- Redwood to request AWS private offer activation immediately after PO receipt; Karthik will run smoke tests and report back within 24 hours
- Invoice target: first invoice within 5 business days post-activation

Maya — can you confirm when Procurement will push the signed DocuSign to AWS? If you’re comfortable with the redlines we’ll queue the activation.

Jonas
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Attachments: final-AurumTech-MAP.xlsx, RDW-SLA-exception-request.pdf

Onward: HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/RDW-2028-AUR-001
